problem: It says 'A mixer-settler gives one equilibrium stage per mixer plus settler', which clashes with Section 1: a real stage reaches only a fraction of equilibrium (E is typically 0.8-0.95), so it does not give a full equilibrium stage.
fix: A mixer-settler gives one real stage per mixer plus settler; with a typical stage efficiency of 0.8-0.95 it counts as roughly one theoretical stage, not exactly one equilibrium stage.

problem: 'Pulsed units are in 5.6' is an unclear cross-reference. A student reading on a phone cannot tell whether 5.6 is a section number or a chapter number, and it is not a link.
fix: Pulsed and reciprocating-plate columns are covered in the chapter on pulsed contactors: pulsed columns.

where: Section 3 table, mixer-settler row, Capacity column
problem: 'High per unit' is undefined: per unit of what? The text later defines capacity as throughput per unit area or volume, so the entry should name the basis.
fix: High throughput per unit volume (but low throughput per unit floor area).

problem: 'Z is the packed height (m)' is incorrect for the spray and mechanically agitated columns discussed in the same section, where there is no packing; the formula is presented for columns in general.
fix: Z is the height of the contacting section (m); for a packed column this is the packed height.
